RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts

An all-male panel is a reason to ask about recruitment safeguards, not proof that sex influenced the decision. Your stronger publication record and completed PhD warrant questions, but industry experience, teaching performance and advertised criteria could legitimately explain the outcome.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and the university’s panel-composition policy. You can neutrally ask whether this panel complied with that policy.

If explanations reveal inconsistent standards, procedural breaches or sex-based remarks, consider a formal complaint. Check applicable deadlines now; they may run while you await a response.
